map.：布重 1000 g、染料浓度 2%（o.w.f）→ 染料 = 1000 × 2: : fabric weight 1000 g, dye concentration 2% (o.w.f) -> dye = 1000 * 2% = 20 g; bath ratio 1:10 -> bath volume = 1000 * 10 = 10000 mL = 10 L.
map.：红 60% + 黄 30% + 蓝 10% 共 20 g → 红 12 g、黄: : red 60% + yellow 30% + blue 10% total 20 g -> red 12 g, yellow 6 g, blue 2 g; scaling up to 5 kg fabric multiplies each by 5.

map.浴比过大染料利用率低、能耗高；过小匀染差，需按设备与染料特性选 1:8–1:15: Too large a bath ratio lowers dye-utilization and raises energy use; too small gives poor leveling; commonly choose 1:8-1:15 by equipment and dye characteristics.
